title: Openergy vs Synergy on macOS
subtitle: Recorded measurements on Apple silicon, macOS 27.2. Lower is better. 1 MiB = 1,024 KiB.
footnote: Different setups, not a matched benchmark. Synergy memory: service + tray + core, GUI closed (2026-10-21).
Openergy memory: daemon only, virtual backend (2026-10-25). Sources: README, “Openergy vs Synergy”.

synergy.source: docs/re/04-tray-security-packaging.md, sum of 3 processes, highest of 3 samples

openergy.source: maintainer measurement, daemon, server role, 10 samples over 60 s
